## Maintenance

A plugin counts as recently released if any version came out in the six months
up to that month.

```{python}
#| renderings: [light, dark]
show(plots.plugin_maintenance(data.plugin_maintenance()))
```

## The plugin template

New plugins made from the [napari-plugin-template](https://github.com/napari/napari-plugin-template)
(cookiecutter until mid-2024, copier since), found from each plugin's repo and
PyPI description.

```{python}
#| renderings: [light, dark]
show(plots.template_usage_by_year(data.template_usage_by_year()))
```

## napari downloads

Monthly downloads of napari from PyPI, from
[ClickHouse's public PyPI dataset](https://clickpy.clickhouse.com/dashboard/napari).
It counts every download, CI included.

```{python}
#| renderings: [light, dark]
show(plots.pypi_downloads(data.pypi_downloads()))
```
